arguments.rule_content:
rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_Raw : RedTeam FalsePositive {
    meta:
        description = "Detect raw Cobalt Strike beacon shellcode in memory or files"
        author = "SOC_Team"
        confidence = "high"
        redteam_test = "RT-2026-0088"
        false_positive_aware = true
    strings:
        $beacon_config = { 2E 72 63 64 2E 64 6C 6C 00 } // ".rcd.dll"
        $stager_x86 = { 60 6A 01 68 [4] 68 [4] E8 [4] 61 } // x86 reflective loader
        $stager_x64 = { 48 83 EC 28 48 89 4C 24 20 E8 } // x64 stager
    condition:
        any of ($stager_*) and $beacon_config
}
